summary: Advances a wide-character stream read: decrements the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x2C, then reads the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x1C, adds 2 to it, and returns the pre-adjustment value. Shape matches a get-next-increment (gninc) on a wide-character buffer; the structural twin of PointerOffsetAdjuster (0059a407) with the sign of each adjustment flipped. Called by MSVCStreambufUflow and sub_59A103.

local_names.this: stream/buffer object whose this+0x1C and this+0x2C hold pointers to the position and count dwords
local_names.v1: pointer read from this+0x1C that holds the buffer position dword
local_names.result: pre-adjustment position value returned to the caller

operations.description: Decrements the dword value at the pointer stored in this+0x2C by one; interpreted as lowering an available/remaining count when one character is consumed.
Reads the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x1C (this[7]) into the result; the current byte-oriented buffer position.
Adds 2 to the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x1C, advancing the buffer position by two bytes (one wide character).
Returns the pre-adjustment position value captured before the two-byte advance.
Called by MSVCStreambufUflow (0x00599D31) and sub_59A103 (0x0059A103), both supplying the this object for their stream-advance paths.

unresolved: The std::streambuf-like get/increment interpretation behind this+0x1C and this+0x2C is DERIVED from the raw body and the ABI lead (std__Gninc); the exact owner class and buffer-width contract are not independently confirmed.
Equal offsets on unrelated this pointers elsewhere are not proof the fields or owner class are identical.

The relationship between this function and its structural twin PointerOffsetAdjuster (0059a407) is prelabeled as a cluster copy; identical instruction shape is not proof of identical object semantics.
